title: Learning to Play Like a Pro: Adaptive Motion Planning and Tracking for Humanoid Robots
summary: This White Paper provides roboticists and control engineers with a comprehensive overview of how motion planning and motion tracking can be decoupled to preserve professional athletic style in humanoid robots, and why adaptive, speed-aware control is essential for closing the gap
